note: One docs page per daisyUI component: /components/<name>/ (68; e.g. /components/navbar/, /components/aura/ = 'Tailwind Aura Component – daisyUI'). The first template captures the element when the component name is a taxonomy id or alias (navbar, button, card …), the second keeps the rest (aura, join, kbd, mockup-browser …) as items tagged from their name; both slug the same path segment, so ids stay stable. /docs/install/* and /blog/* are not components.
